CustomField.description: Dispatches to the per-section Requester-Info-Complete field based on the parent Case's Type. Case Types with no seller-filled Requester fields yet default to true (never blocks Submit).
CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(Case__r.Type) = "InfoSecurity", INFOSEC_Requester_Info_Complete__c, IF(TEXT(Case__r.Type) = "Bid Management", BM_Requester_Info_Complete__c, IF(TEXT(Case__r.Type) = "Remarketing", RMKT_Requester_Info_Complete__c, IF(TEXT(Case__r.Type) = "Solution Architects", SA_Requester_Info_Complete__c, IF(TEXT(Case__r.Type) = "Deal Desk", DD_Requester_Info_Complete__c, IF(TEXT(Case__r.Type) = "Revenue Management", REVMGMT_Requester_Info_Complete__c, IF(TEXT(Case__r.Type) = "Legal", LEGAL_Requester_Info_Complete__c, true)))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System field — reflects whether all requester-facing fields for this Case's type are filled in.
CustomField.label: Requester Info Complete
